stance_rationale: Fresh walk-forward returns exist, but the package fails core Forge verification: Pure Function hash scope is incomplete, target stage artifacts are missing, baseline/DSR/Harvey evidence is not same-period, and charts are not generated from the fresh rebacktest output. The strongest claims rely on documented or inherited evidence instead of the package under critique.

critical_concerns.description: Pure Function audit is not valid for the required 3-package contract: risk_package.json is absent, optimization_package.json has no best_combo, and the fresh script falls back to hard-coded Iter31 defaults while claiming extraction from optimization_package. The canonical stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010/alpha_scores.parquet also changed from 749f4bcf... to 703ffbf3..., but that mutable dependency is outside the package's start/end hash scope.

The user-specified target stage dirs qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-P20260429_002 and stage_artifacts/WT_P20260429_002 do not exist, and the requested alpha_scores.parquet/covariance.parquet are missing there. Root weights.csv has 267 dates ending 2026-03-01, while the fresh package claims 269 alpha sig_dates through 2026-05-01 and 268 periods through 2026-05-01.

The comparison uses documented frozen-admit SR 1.6399 with a known period mismatch rather than a same-period, same-cost, same-DSR baseline. No CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 Newey-West t_NW evidence exists for the fresh rebacktest, and the DSR penalty uses an assumed 30 candidates only on the candidate side.
critical_concerns.ax_cite: AX-008; PIT-C14; L-122; RF-F4; RF-F5; RF-F6

critical_concerns.description: The only WT-P20260429_002 PNGs are equity_curve_may2026.png and oos_zoom_chart_may2026.png, but 04_oos_zoom_chart.R explicitly reuses existing production NAV from 04_Research/strategies/.../output/02_nav.csv with max date 2026-03, not the fresh output_full_rebacktest NAV through 2026-05. output_full_rebacktest has no annual_returns.png or exact oos_zoom_chart.png.

production_constraints_pass states max_weight_le_0p20=true, but output_full_rebacktest holdings include CASH at 0.40 in 4 CRISIS periods, and root weights.csv has cash 0.2650591 on 2026-03-01. If cash is exempt from the 20% per-name bound, the package must explicitly separate risk-name caps from cash overlay caps instead of reporting unconditional max_weight pass.

The package uses 'minor', 'schedule extension routine', 'Method shopping NOT applicable', 'NEGLIGIBLE', 'sanity check', and 'Re-litigation 불필요' while baseline, Harvey, target artifact, and chart evidence remain unresolved. This is a No Silent Override risk, not a substitute for verification.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores_extended.parquet is a real time-series artifact: 80,183 rows, 269 Dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-05-01, 846 unique tickers, and no duplicated Date-Ticker keys.

output_full_rebacktest/03_period_returns.csv has 268 periods with sig_date range 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01 and period_end range 2004-02-02 to 2026-05-01, so this is not merely a single-snapshot backtest.

Turnover cost arithmetic in 03_period_returns.csv is internally consistent: cost equals 0.0015 × turnover × 2, average monthly one-way turnover is 0.4652054, and annualized one-way turnover is 5.582465 below the 600% hard cap.

Risk holdings excluding CASH pass basic constraints in output_full_rebacktest: 19-20 risk names per period, no negative weights, sum including cash equals 1, and risk-name max weight stays within 0.20.
The inherited covariance at stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010/covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.003300942 and condition 24.3401, but the critique-target covariance path is missing.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Forge is allowed to mutate stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010/alpha_scores.parquet after preserving a backup, or whether fresh artifacts must live only under the WT-P20260429_002 target stage path.
Whether CASH is exempt from the 20% max weight hard constraint; the package reports max_weight_le_0p20 without that qualification.
Which baseline is binding for RF-F4: frozen-admit M4 1.6399, same-period fresh recomputed frozen-alpha, SYN_06 replacement baseline, or root weights.csv M4 schedule.
Whether candidates_tried_total=30 is complete across alpha, optimizer, M4 overlay, and May 2026 recompute attempts.
Whether AX-008 can pass when Architect is skipped and Codex challenge concerns are only self-classified as resolved.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that extending alpha through 2026-05 is only an input-data refresh and therefore preserves Pure Function/admission status, despite canonical alpha artifact mutation, missing risk_package/best_combo evidence, and absent same-period Harvey/DSR baseline.
rebuttal_required: Provide target qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-P20260429_002 and/or stage_artifacts/WT_P20260429_002 alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet, or correct the declared artifact paths.
Add a real 3-package hash audit including risk_package.json, or formally document why risk is out of scope and how covariance is frozen.
Put Iter31 best_combo parameters in optimization_package.json or prove the hard-coded defaults are byte-for-byte inherited from the admitted optimizer artifact.
Run same-period, same-cost, same-DSR baseline comparison and full CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 Newey-West t_NW for the fresh rebacktest.
Regenerate equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png from output_full_rebacktest/02_nav.csv, not the older production NAV.
Clarify cash-overlay cap treatment and revise production_constraints_pass so it distinguishes risk-name max weight from cash weight.
rationalization_red_flags: out of scope for routine monthly deploy

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Fresh walk-forward files materially improve over the prior draft, but AX-008 still fails because independent same-period baseline/Harvey evidence and the declared target artifacts are absent, while Forge's self-resolution relies on scope exclusion.

forge_specific_questions: Pure Function v6.1 R12 hash audit이 PRE=POST 모두 일치하는가? No: selected hashes match, but risk_package is absent, best_combo is not in optimization_package, and canonical alpha_scores was mutated outside the audit scope.

walk-forward 시계열 충분 (≥60 sig_dates)이고 single-snapshot 위험 없는가? Partially: alpha_extended has 269 dates and returns have 268 periods, but root weights.csv remains 267 dates ending 2026-03 and monthly_returns.parquet is missing.
Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? Not for the fresh rebacktest: the available May chart uses older production NAV ending 2026-03, not output_full_rebacktest NAV through 2026-05.

baseline 비교가 same-period · same-cost · same-DSR-penalty인가? No: the package compares against documented frozen-admit SR and assumes the DSR penalty rather than recomputing the baseline on the same period.
